scope: Illustrative configured workplace scenarios, not live tests or claims that every framework natively includes the named connector. Mechanism behavior follows the pinned implementation evidence in the report. Example setup identifies required tooling or custom ingress.

scenarios.english: You assign your colleague to watch customer mail during office hours. Each scheduled check uses the Outlook reader; if a customer needs an answer today, they put a reminder in your configured private inbox. Nothing urgent means no reminder.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你交代同事上班時間留意客戶來信。到了檢查時間，他用 Outlook 工具查新信；客戶要求今天答覆，就在你的私人收件匣提醒你，沒有急事就不打擾。
scenarios.example_setup: Outlook reader + private inbox / Outlook 讀信工具＋私人收件匣
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The check starts without another request; the agent decides whether the mail warrants a reminder.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 不用你再叫他查信；檢查會自行啟動，是否提醒則由 agent 判斷。

scenarios.english: You schedule an inbox brief for 09:00 every weekday. At nine, your colleague uses the Outlook reader to collect new mail and prepares a list of senders, key requests and replies you owe. The report goes to the destination you configured.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你設定每個上班日 09:00 收到信箱摘要。九點一到，同事就用 Outlook 工具讀新信，列出誰來信、要什麼、哪些等你回覆，再送到你指定的位置。
scenarios.example_setup: Outlook reader + report delivery / Outlook 讀信工具＋報告送達管道
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The saved schedule starts the inbox brief at the assigned time, without a new message from you.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 排程到時就啟動信箱摘要，不必每天重新交辦。

scenarios.english: A contract is marked ready for review in your document system. Your integration sends that notice to /hooks/agent; your colleague uses the SharePoint reader to open the contract and prepares review comments in your private inbox.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 合約在文件系統被標成「待審查」。你接好的整合程式把通知送到 /hooks/agent，同事便用 SharePoint 工具讀合約，把審查意見整理到你的私人收件匣。
scenarios.example_setup: Document-system webhook + SharePoint reader / 文件系統事件接線＋SharePoint 讀取工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The document event starts the review; you do not have to notice the status change and assign it again.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 文件狀態事件啟動審查，不必你先發現變更、再交辦一次。

scenarios.english: Your colleague starts a long-running data check with a command-line tool. When that command exits, on-exit starts the follow-up: read the output file and list the records that failed. Nobody needs to keep asking whether the check is finished.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事用命令列工具啟動一批資料檢查，可能要跑半小時。程式一結束，on-exit 就啟動後續處理：讀取結果檔，列出哪些資料沒過，不必由你一直追問跑完沒。
scenarios.example_setup: Supervised command + result-file reader / 受管理的命令＋結果檔讀取工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: Command completion starts the result review, without waiting for you to ask whether it finished.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 命令一結束就接續讀結果，不用等你追問跑完沒。

scenarios.english: Your colleague runs a log-watching command. Within seconds it reports “checkout failed”, “payment timeout”, then “checkout recovered”. The stream mechanism groups these lines before waking the colleague, who reads them together and tells you that checkout recovered but payment still needs attention.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事讓一支程式持續讀系統紀錄。幾秒內先後出現「結帳失敗」「付款逾時」「結帳恢復」，stream 會先把這批訊息一起交給同事；他看完再告訴你：「結帳恢復了，但付款還要查。」
scenarios.example_setup: Log watcher stdout/stderr + configured notification / 紀錄監看程式輸出＋指定通知管道
scenarios.proactive_key_en: New watcher output prompts follow-up after batching; the agent interprets the collected messages.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 監看程式有新輸出就交給同事處理；先收成一批，再由 agent 判斷狀況。

scenarios.english: You want to know if the nightly data import fails. A small script checks the job-status API; “running” does nothing, while “failed” starts the colleague. They then use the log-reading tool to find the failed step and prepare a summary.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你想知道夜間資料匯入有沒有失敗。小程式先查工作狀態 API：「執行中」就不叫同事，「失敗」才啟動他；他再用紀錄查詢工具找出卡在哪一步，整理原因給你。
scenarios.example_setup: Custom status-check script + log reader / 自訂狀態檢查程式＋紀錄查詢工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The checking script decides when to start the agent; a failed import triggers investigation without another request.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 檢查 script 決定何時叫 agent；匯入失敗就啟動調查，不必再交辦。

scenarios.english: While checking a payment incident through the monitoring API, your colleague finds it unresolved. They request another check in five minutes instead of thirty. If the run succeeds and that delay is allowed, the runtime saves the earlier check time.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事用監控 API 查付款異常，發現還沒恢復，就要求「五分鐘後再查，不要等半小時」。這次執行成功、間隔也符合設定限制，系統才把下次檢查改到五分鐘後。
scenarios.example_setup: Monitoring API + next_check / 監控 API＋下次檢查時間設定
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The agent proposes when to check again; the runtime applies the change only after a successful, valid run.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: Agent 自己提出下次何時再查；執行成功且符合限制，runtime 才採用。

scenarios.english: Your colleague finishes a difficult weekly report and discovers a reliable way to clean the spreadsheet. If the work qualifies for Workshop review, a later review uses file-editing tools to improve the permitted reporting instructions. This helps with the next report; it does not start one now.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事做完一份很難整理的週報，找到可靠的試算表清理方法。這次工作若符合 Workshop 回顧條件，後續回顧就用檔案編輯工具，把做法補進允許修改的週報指引，供下次使用。
scenarios.example_setup: Completed work + permitted skill files / 已完成工作紀錄＋允許修改的技能檔
scenarios.proactive_key_en: Eligible completed work starts a background review that improves permitted instructions for next time.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 符合條件的已完成工作會啟動背景回顧，把做法補進允許修改的指引。

scenarios.english: Project work has left useful facts scattered across your colleague’s notes. At the configured memory-maintenance time, Dreaming organizes those notes and retains useful information for later work. It reads stored memory rather than checking Outlook for new assignments.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事處理專案後，留下不少零散筆記。到了設定好的記憶整理時間，Dreaming 就整理已保存的內容，留下之後工作用得到的資訊；這次讀的是記憶檔，不是去 Outlook 找新任務。
scenarios.example_setup: Stored memory + maintenance tools / 已保存記憶＋整理工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: Scheduled maintenance organizes stored memory without a new request; it does not discover external tasks.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 記憶整理排程自行啟動，整理已存內容；這一步不是去外部找新任務。

scenarios.english: You assign a quarterly report and set a budget. The goal tools save the assignment in session state.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你交辦季報並設定預算，目標工具把這份交辦保存到對話狀態。
scenarios.example_setup: Goal storage; automatic restart unverified / 目標儲存；自動再啟動未證實
scenarios.proactive_key_en: This stores the assigned goal; storage alone does not start another working turn.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 這一步只保存交辦目標；保存本身不會自動啟動下一輪工作。

scenarios.english: You save a daily 09:00 job: read Outlook and list mail that needs a reply. At nine, Cron starts a fresh agent session, which uses the configured mail reader and sends the summary to your chosen chat. You do not need to open a conversation first.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你存下一項每天 09:00 的工作：「讀 Outlook，列出待回覆郵件。」九點到了，Cron 就開新工作對話，用接好的讀信工具查信，再把摘要送到指定聊天室，不必等你先開口。
scenarios.example_setup: Configured Outlook reader + chat delivery / 已接好的 Outlook 讀信工具＋聊天室送達
scenarios.proactive_key_en: Cron starts the saved inbox task and delivery path without waiting for a morning message.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: Cron 自行啟動已存的讀信工作與送達流程，不必等你早上開口。

scenarios.english: A customer submits a new support ticket. Your support system sends a webhook with the ticket ID; after its checks pass, Hermes starts your colleague. They use the ticket-reading tool to understand the problem and prepare a reply draft for review.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 客戶送出一張客服單，客服系統就用 webhook 傳來單號。通知通過檢查後，同事開始工作：用客服單查詢工具讀問題，準備一份給你確認的回覆草稿。
scenarios.example_setup: Support webhook + ticket reader / 客服系統 webhook＋案件查詢工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: An accepted ticket event starts the work; the integration supplies the trigger and the agent prepares the response.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 通過檢查的客服單事件啟動工作；整合程式送事件，agent 準備回覆。

scenarios.english: In a project conversation, you ask your colleague to periodically revisit a supplier follow-up. When /heartbeat admits a check, they use Outlook search to see whether the supplier replied and update you if needed. New work you are actively assigning takes priority.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你在專案對話裡交代同事定期追供應商回覆。/heartbeat 到了可檢查的時間，就讓他用 Outlook 搜尋工具看看對方回信沒，必要時提醒你；若你正在交辦工作，先處理你的要求。
scenarios.example_setup: Session instructions + Outlook search / 對話內交辦＋Outlook 搜尋工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The session heartbeat revisits the assigned follow-up when eligible, while giving your active requests priority.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: Session heartbeat 在可執行時回來追交辦事項，並優先處理你正在提出的要求。

scenarios.english: You ask your colleague to check a large file upload every few minutes until it finishes. Each /loop turn uses the upload-status API, then waits before trying again. Completion or the configured limit stops the checks.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你請同事每隔幾分鐘看看大檔案上傳好了沒。每次 /loop 啟動，他就查上傳狀態 API，還沒好就等下一次；上傳完成，或到達設定上限，就停止檢查。
scenarios.example_setup: Upload-status API + stop condition / 上傳狀態 API＋停止條件
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The loop repeats the assigned status check within its stop conditions; it is not choosing a new task.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: Loop 在停止條件內重複查交辦的狀態，不必你一直追問；不是自己選新任務。

scenarios.english: You ask your colleague to fix the failing tests. They edit the files and run the test command; if tests still fail, /goal evaluates whether more work is needed and allowed. Within the remaining budget, it starts another turn to inspect the failure and try the next fix.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你請同事把測試修到通過。他用檔案編輯工具修改，再用命令列跑測試；如果還沒過，/goal 會判斷是否需要繼續、額度是否允許，再讓他查失敗原因、試下一個修正。
scenarios.example_setup: File editor + test command / 檔案編輯工具＋測試命令
scenarios.proactive_key_en: After a turn, goal evaluation decides whether to continue the repair, wait or stop within its limits.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 回合結束後，目標評估決定繼續修、等待或停止，並受設定限制。

scenarios.english: An analyst’s task is waiting for another colleague to finish preparing a sales CSV. Once the parent task is marked done, the next Kanban scan can dispatch the analysis if capacity is available. The analyst reads the CSV with a data-analysis tool and prepares the sales summary.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 分析同事的工作，要等另一位同事備妥銷售 CSV。前置任務標成完成後，下次 Kanban 掃描若有執行空間，就派送分析工作；分析同事再用資料分析工具讀 CSV、整理銷售摘要。
scenarios.example_setup: Kanban task dependencies + CSV analysis / Kanban 任務依賴＋CSV 分析工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The dispatcher notices completed prerequisites on a scan and assigns ready work when capacity allows.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: Dispatcher 掃描到前置工作完成、也有執行空間時，就派送下一份工作。

scenarios.english: Your colleague finishes diagnosing a report-generation failure using logs and scripts. If background review is enabled and the work qualifies, it revisits the completed work and records useful troubleshooting steps in permitted files. It does not start another customer case.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事用紀錄與腳本查完一件報表產生失敗的問題。若已啟用回顧、工作也符合條件，背景回顧就重看這次處理經過，把有用的排查步驟寫進允許修改的檔案。
scenarios.example_setup: Completed run + restricted file writes / 已完成執行紀錄＋受限制的檔案寫入
scenarios.proactive_key_en: Enabled review logic starts a qualifying retrospective without a separate request to document the lesson.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 啟用的回顧邏輯會對符合條件的工作啟動回顧，不必另請他整理經驗。

scenarios.english: Your company uses Chronos to schedule the daily inbox brief. At 09:00, Chronos sends Hermes the scheduled-run request; Hermes first claims that occurrence, then starts the saved job. Your colleague reads Outlook through the configured tool and delivers the brief.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 公司用 Chronos 統一排每天的信箱摘要。09:00 到了，Chronos 通知 Hermes；Hermes 先取得這次工作的執行權，再請同事用接好的 Outlook 工具讀信、送出摘要。
scenarios.example_setup: Chronos + configured Outlook reader / Chronos 排程＋已接好的 Outlook 讀信工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The external schedule supplies the wake; Hermes claims that occurrence before doing the assigned work.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 外部排程提供喚醒；Hermes 先取得這次工作的執行權，再做交辦事項。

scenarios.english: A configured script queries Outlook and returns a stable list of message IDs every few minutes. Hermes compares it with the previous output: an identical list skips the agent; the first observation or a changed list wakes your colleague to read the mail and decide whether to notify you.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你接一支小程式，每隔幾分鐘查 Outlook，固定格式列出郵件 ID。Hermes 首次取得清單或發現內容有變，才請同事讀信、判斷是否需要提醒你；清單沒變就不叫他。
scenarios.example_setup: Custom Outlook polling script + mail reader / 自訂 Outlook 輪詢程式＋讀信工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The source check runs on schedule; first or changed output starts the agent, while unchanged output skips it.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 排程先查資料；首次或內容有變才啟動 agent，沒變就略過。

scenarios.english: You set a Friday routine to prepare the team update. When it becomes due, OpenBot assigns the work to your colleague, who reads the connected project channel using their current permissions and posts the summary to the configured channel.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你設定每週五整理團隊進度。排程到了，OpenBot 把工作交給同事；他用目前的權限讀已連接的專案頻道，整理本週完成事項，再回傳到指定頻道。
scenarios.example_setup: Connected project channel + channel delivery / 已連接的專案頻道＋頻道送達
scenarios.proactive_key_en: A saved routine becomes queued work at the scheduled time, without another assignment from you.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 既定 routine 到時成為佇列工作，不必你重新派工。

scenarios.english: While preparing a report, your project colleague finds a number they cannot explain. They use message_bot to ask the authorized data specialist to check it. The specialist uses their own database tool and access rights to investigate and return an explanation.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 專案同事做報告時，發現一個數字解釋不清楚，就用 message_bot 請獲准協作的資料專家幫忙。專家收到任務後，用自己的資料庫工具與權限查數字來源，再回覆原因。
scenarios.example_setup: message_bot + specialist database tool / message_bot 派工＋專家的資料庫工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: One bot delegates through message_bot so the specialist can receive the task without a human handoff.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: Bot 用 message_bot 交給專家處理，不必由你在兩位同事間轉述任務。

scenarios.english: The data specialist finishes checking a disputed sales number and returns an answer. Handoff result relay delivers it to the project colleague who asked the question. The explanation reaches the original requester without you copying it between conversations.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 資料專家查完有疑問的銷售數字，交回答案。Handoff result relay 會把成果送回原本提問的專案同事，讓他收到後續資訊，不必由你在兩段對話之間複製貼上。
scenarios.example_setup: message_bot result + requesting conversation / message_bot 成果＋原始求助對話
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The result relay returns delegated findings to the requester without manual copying between conversations.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 成果自動送回派工者，不必你在對話間複製貼上。

scenarios.english: Your colleague is running a long database analysis. While that work continues, a background heartbeat renews their claim on the task so ownership remains recorded. It neither asks the colleague to check another system nor starts a new model turn.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事正在用資料庫工具跑一份很久的分析。背後的 heartbeat 定期替任務續租，維持「這份工作由他負責」的紀錄；它不會叫同事去查別的系統，也不會另開一輪思考。
scenarios.example_setup: Queue lease renewal during existing work / 既有工作執行中的佇列續租
scenarios.proactive_key_en: This heartbeat renews work ownership; it supports reliable execution but starts no new agent turn.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 這個 heartbeat 只續租工作執行權，支援可靠執行；不會啟動新的 agent 回合。

scenarios.english: A cloud automation record arrives. The local client polls for new records, validates the request and starts the matching automation.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 雲端出現一筆自動化執行紀錄。本機程式輪詢讀到新紀錄，檢查要求後，啟動對應的自動化工作。
scenarios.example_setup: Reconstructed cloud receiver + configured repository reader / 重建版雲端接收器＋需配置的程式庫讀取工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The local consumer discovers a new automation record and starts its work; cloud scheduling is outside this trace.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 本機接收程式讀到新自動化紀錄就啟動工作；這條路徑不說明雲端如何排程。

scenarios.english: Your integration receives a build-failure notice and places it in the colleague’s existing conversation. When that conversation is idle, the reconstructed host can start a follow-up. With a log-reading tool configured, the colleague can inspect the failure and draft findings.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你接好的整合程式收到建置失敗通知，把它放進同事原本的對話。對話閒置時，重建版程式可啟動後續處理；若已配置紀錄查詢工具，同事就能讀失敗紀錄、整理發現。
scenarios.example_setup: Custom event integration + log reader / 自訂事件接線＋紀錄查詢工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: An incoming background event can resume an idle conversation without a new user message.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 背景事件到來，可以接續閒置對話，不必你再送一則訊息。

scenarios.english: Your colleague delegates a repository investigation to another agent and waits. When that agent finishes, the reconstructed host collects its result and requests a follow-up in the original conversation. Duplicate completion notices do not trigger the same handoff again.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事請另一個 agent 用程式庫工具調查問題，自己先等結果。對方完成後，重建版程式收下成果，要求接續原本的對話；同一份完成通知重送，不會再算一次。
scenarios.example_setup: Delegated agent result + original conversation / 委派 agent 成果＋原始對話
scenarios.proactive_key_en: A delegated result requests continuation of the waiting conversation; duplicate completions are checked.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 委派成果回來會要求接續等待中的對話，並檢查重複完成通知。

scenarios.english: A continuation request arrives after several turns without tool work. The handler checks the goal and pauses it when the no-progress guard is reached.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事連續幾輪沒使用工具，又收到續跑要求。處理器檢查目標，達到空轉門檻就暫停，不再讓他一直回話。
scenarios.example_setup: Continuation request + progress guard / 續跑要求＋進度檢查
scenarios.proactive_key_en: This guard stops ineffective continuation after the no-tool threshold; it does not generate new work.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 這個控制在無工具進展達門檻時停止無效續跑；本身不會產生新工作。

scenarios.english: You start Voyager with the direction to explore Minecraft. It reads the surroundings, inventory and task history, then asks its curriculum model to select the next task; after acting and checking the result, it chooses again.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你啟動 Voyager，給它探索 Minecraft 的方向。它讀周遭環境、背包與任務歷史，由 curriculum 模型選下一個任務；操作並檢查成果後，再選下一件事。
scenarios.example_setup: Minecraft state + game-action code / Minecraft 狀態＋遊戲操作程式
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The curriculum model chooses the next exploration task from observations and history, without an itemized task list.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: Curriculum 模型依觀察與歷史選下一個探索任務，不必你逐件列出要做什麼。

scenarios.english: The Minecraft agent runs crafting code, but the game reports that materials are missing. The agent uses the feedback to revise its code and try the same task again. It stops when verification succeeds or the attempt limit is reached.
scenarios.zh_Hant: Minecraft 同事執行合成程式，遊戲卻回報材料不夠。他會根據回饋修改操作程式、重試同一個任務；確認成功，或嘗試次數用完，就停止。
scenarios.example_setup: Game feedback + code execution + verification / 遊戲回饋＋程式執行＋成果驗證
scenarios.proactive_key_en: Environment feedback drives a revised attempt on the same task, until success or the attempt limit.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 環境回饋促使 agent 修正並重試同一任務，直到成功或達到次數上限。

scenarios.english: You schedule a weekday 09:00 review of a local project. When the app starts the task, your colleague reads project files and prepares a short progress brief. For local-project tasks, the app must be running and the computer awake; the schedule does not turn on your laptop.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你在 App 排好每個上班日 09:00 查看本機專案。任務啟動後，同事用檔案工具讀專案資料，整理進度摘要；這類本機工作需要 App 開著、電腦醒著，排程不會替你開機。
scenarios.example_setup: App schedule + local project files / App 排程＋本機專案檔案
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The app schedule starts the saved task when its execution environment is available, without a new message.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 執行環境可用時，App 排程自行啟動既定工作，不必你再開口。

scenarios.english: You give your colleague the goal of making the tests pass. They edit files and run tests; when the turn ends and the goal remains active, the runtime can start another turn within its controls. They continue the assigned repair rather than waiting for another “continue” message.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你給同事的目標是「讓測試通過」。他用編輯工具改檔、用命令列跑測試；回合結束但目標仍有效時，runtime 可在控制條件內再開下一輪，繼續這份修復工作。
scenarios.example_setup: Goal controls + file editor + test command / 目標控制＋檔案編輯＋測試命令
scenarios.proactive_key_en: An active goal can trigger another eligible turn after the thread becomes idle, continuing the same objective.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: Thread 閒置後，有效目標可啟動下一個符合條件的回合，繼續同一目標。

scenarios.english: Your build system reports a failed deployment. A listener you built receives the event and starts Codex through exec or App Server. The colleague then uses shell and file tools to inspect the logs and prepare a fix; Codex itself is not the build-event listener.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 建置系統回報部署失敗，你自己接的監聽程式收到事件，再透過 exec 或 App Server 啟動 Codex。同事才用命令列與檔案工具讀紀錄、準備修正；建置事件的監聽要由整合程式負責。
scenarios.example_setup: Custom build listener + exec/App Server + shell / 自訂建置監聽＋exec/App Server＋命令列工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: Your integration detects the event and starts Codex; exec / App Server provide execution, not the event sensor.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 你的整合程式偵測事件並啟動 Codex；exec／App Server 提供執行介面，不負責感測事件。

scenarios.english: Your colleague finishes checking a build. The turn-completion notification calls your configured script, which displays a desktop notice saying the result is ready. The script delivers the notice; it does not start another investigation.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事完成建置檢查後，回合結束通知會呼叫你設定的腳本。腳本跳出桌面提醒：「結果好了，可以查看。」這是在送通知，不是再啟動同事查一次。
scenarios.example_setup: Configured notify script + desktop notification / 已設定的 notify 腳本＋桌面通知
scenarios.proactive_key_en: Turn completion invokes a configured notification script; it reports the result rather than starting new work.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 回合結束呼叫已設定的通知 script，主動告知結果，不會另開工作。

scenarios.english: While a deployment runs, you ask /loop to check every five minutes. Each check uses the deployment-status command and reports when the deployment is ready. This is a session schedule: the colleague is not independently watching after the session is gone.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 部署還在跑，你用 /loop 交代每五分鐘看一次。每次啟動，同事就用部署狀態命令查進度，完成後回報；這是對話內排程，對話結束後不會自己在外面繼續盯。
scenarios.example_setup: /loop + deployment-status command / /loop＋部署狀態命令
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The schedule revisits the deployment check without repeated prompts; this example repeats an assigned task.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 排程自行回來查部署，不必你反覆追問；此情境是在重複既定任務。

scenarios.english: Your colleague starts a long-running log watcher through Monitor. When the watcher outputs a new error, that output returns to the session and prompts investigation. The colleague can then use shell tools to inspect the surrounding logs.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事透過 Monitor 啟動一支持續看紀錄的程式。程式輸出新錯誤時，消息回到對話，才促使他查原因；接著他可用命令列工具讀錯誤前後的紀錄。
scenarios.example_setup: Monitor + log-watching process + shell / Monitor＋紀錄監看程式＋命令列工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: Monitor output enters the session as events, prompting follow-up without another message from you.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: Monitor 輸出以事件進入對話，促成後續處理，不必你再傳訊息。

scenarios.english: A teammate sends a message to the connected Telegram bot: “The latest build failed.” The channel delivers it into your colleague’s session. With repository and shell tools available, the colleague checks the problem and can reply through the Telegram channel.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事在已連接的 Telegram bot 留言：「最新建置失敗了。」Channel 把訊息送進數位同事的對話；若已提供程式庫與命令列工具，他就查問題，並可透過 Telegram 回覆。
scenarios.example_setup: Telegram channel + repository/shell tools / Telegram 頻道＋程式庫與命令列工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: A connected channel brings the external message into the working session without manual forwarding.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 已連接的 channel 把外部訊息帶入工作對話，不必手動轉貼。

scenarios.english: You schedule a morning review of your project folder in Desktop. At the scheduled time, your colleague reads the local files and prepares a brief of changes and open issues. The desktop app and computer must be available for this local work.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你在 Desktop 排好每天早上整理專案資料夾。時間到了，同事就讀本機檔案，列出最新變更與未解問題；這份本機工作需要桌面 App 與電腦可用。
scenarios.example_setup: Desktop scheduled task + local file tools / Desktop 排程工作＋本機檔案工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The desktop schedule starts the local project check when the app and machine are available.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: App 與電腦可用時，桌面排程自行啟動本機專案檢查。

scenarios.english: You configure a cloud routine to review new pull requests. A PR is opened after you close your laptop; the configured trigger starts the cloud run, which reads the repository changes and records review findings. The work runs in the cloud environment you set up.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 你先設定「有新 PR 就審查」的雲端 routine。關了筆電之後有人開 PR，已接好的觸發就啟動雲端工作，讀取程式庫變更並留下審查結果；工作在事先設定的雲端環境執行。
scenarios.example_setup: Configured PR trigger + cloud repository access / 已設定的 PR 觸發＋雲端程式庫存取
scenarios.proactive_key_en: The configured cloud trigger starts the saved PR review even when your laptop is off.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 已設定的雲端觸發自行啟動 PR 審查，筆電關閉也不影響這份雲端工作。

scenarios.english: Your colleague edits a file, and an edit hook runs your configured check. If your Stop hook finds unfinished work when the colleague tries to finish, it can require follow-up. The check script supplies the condition; the colleague then uses editing and test tools to address it.
scenarios.zh_Hant: 同事改完檔案，編輯後的 hook 就跑你指定的檢查。若他準備結束時，Stop hook 查到還有未完成事項，就可要求接著處理，再用編輯與測試工具補完；判斷條件由你的檢查腳本提供。
scenarios.example_setup: Edit/Stop hooks + check script + editor / 編輯與 Stop hooks＋檢查腳本＋編輯工具
scenarios.proactive_key_en: Lifecycle hooks run configured checks; a Stop hook can require follow-up when its script finds unfinished work.
scenarios.proactive_key_zh_Hant: 生命週期 hook 自行跑設定的檢查；Stop hook 的 script 發現未完成事項時，可要求接續處理。
